# JsonCpp

This directory contains the amalgamated JsonCpp 1.9.7 source generated from
official commit `3455302847cf1e4671f1d8f5fa953fd46a7b1404` by running:

```text
python amalgamate.py
```

Upstream: https://github.com/open-source-parsers/jsoncpp

JsonCpp is distributed under the Public Domain/MIT terms in `LICENSE`.
